components.name: Water and wastewater consumption rate
components.rate_display: C$4.8629/m³, block 1 — defined by the City as a combined water and wastewater rate

grade_reason: The published rate is a combined water and wastewater consumption rate. No supply-only tariff is published, so no supply figure exists to standardise. Rule 3.3: left empty rather than estimated.
superseded_note: Source capture completed 17 August 2026 against the statutory schedule, which turned out to be dated February 2025 — so the real record is a closed 2025 observation at C$4.6872, not the 2026 rate the draft assumed. The draft was also more pessimistic than the evidence: total water services is Grade A from a by-law, and only the supply metric is Grade C.
